title: Shore Fun Vacation Rental
meta_description: Shore Fun is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionShore FunWaterColor Beach CommunityWestern Lake Dr, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights5 Bedrooms – 4 in the Main House & 1 in the Carriage House5 Full Bathrooms – 4 in the Main House & 1 in the Carriage HouseSleeps 12 Guests3,174 Sq FtCarriage House with Queen Bunk Bedroom, Full Bath, Kitchen & Living AreaMain House1st Floor King Guest Bedroom with Walk-In Shower2nd Floor King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower & Deep Tub2nd Floor King Guest Bedroom with Walk-In Shower2nd Floor King Guest Bedroom with Tub/Shower ComboMultiple screened-in and covered porches/balconies with outdoor seatingSpacious living area with indoor fireplaceDining for 8 plus 4 bar seats at the breakfast barOutdoor shower, covered carport (2–3 vehicles), and gas grillFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb excluded; additional rentals available upon request)Experience the ultimate 30A getaway at Shore Fun! This beautiful Phase I WaterColor home combines comfort and style, featuring spacious living areas, multiple porches, and a separate carriage house with full kitchen and living space. Relax in the living room by the fireplace, dine at the breakfast bar or dining table, or enjoy the outdoors from one of the screened-in balconies.Explore all that WaterColor has to offer, from the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor to boutique shopping, dining, and nature trails.Community AmenitiesMultiple community poolsPrivate beach access via WaterColor Beach ClubCamp WaterColor for kidsWaterColor Town Center: shopping & diningWestern Lake (South Walton’s largest coastal dune lake)Parks, playgrounds, and nature trailsWellness options: spa, tennis courts, Boathouse (additional fees may apply)Golf carts can be rented through The Electric Cart Company (availability limited; one cart per home).ParkingCarport parking for 2–3 vehiclesVehicle registration is required prior to arrival.Reservation & Booking NotesPromotional rates may be available through 30A Cottages & Concierge (not VRBO)Cancellation: 50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior5% cancellation fee; travel insurance availableNO smoking No pets (except certified service animals)Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuest must be at least 25 years oldImportant: WaterColor requires wristbands for all guests 5+ years old to access amenities. Maximum 12 guests per home; wristbands must be arranged at least two weeks before arrival.
